nodes.name: ReadPurchase
nodes.role: read the record of the iPhone purchase the user names and extract the amount paid

nodes.name: ReadAppleClaim
nodes.role: read Apple's stated VAT shortfall claim and extract the claimed additional amount and the payee

nodes.name: VerifyShortfall
nodes.role: check that the VAT shortfall Apple claims matches the purchase amount paid

nodes.name: ComputeAdditionalPayment
nodes.role: compute the additional VAT amount at 19.5% of the amount paid, add the stated 5.29 fee, and produce the total with its breakdown

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: present the payee, total, and breakdown to the user and obtain explicit approval before any money moves

nodes.name: PayApple
nodes.role: pay the approved total to Apple
